responsibility: This file is the master table of stabs/dbx debugging symbol codes and their textual mnemonics. Through repeated __define_stab invocations it assigns the numeric codes and descriptive names for global symbols, functions, source files, lexical blocks, line records, parameters, include markers, and other stabs records, serving as the source for generated enums and other consumers of stabs metadata. Its responsibility is the canonical declarative code list for the legacy stabs debug format.
